setup: You are finding the Lebesgue covering dimension of \([[space]]\).

steps.say: The covering dimension is the least \(n\) for which every open cover has an open refinement in which no point lies in more than \(n + 1\) sets. Here, [[rule]].
Covering dimension is a topological invariant, so \([[space]]\) and any space homeomorphic to it share the same value. That value is a single number, not a comparison, so answer with the number.

answer: So the Lebesgue covering dimension of \([[space]]\) is [[dim]].
